description: Election Commission - M. M. M. Suhaider was elected as the member of the Number 28 - Asgiri walpola of Minuwangoda Pradeshiya Sabha
reasoning: This gazette notice concerns the filling of a vacancy in a local government body (Minuwangoda Pradeshiya Sabha) due to the death of an elected member, following procedures outlined in the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It involves the nomination and declaration of a new elected member, which falls under electoral processes and related matters.
